claims.content: Customer updates and saves changes to their membership account information, including personal details, contact information, password, and email notification preferences.

scope_contract.goal_statement: Customer updates and saves changes to their membership account information, including personal details, contact information, password, and email notification preferences.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer opens the account settings ('Change Membership Account Information') page, enters updated values for their personal/contact details and password, adjusts email notification preferences as desired, and saves the changes successfully.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer is on the account settings page and begins entering updated membership account information.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has saved the updated membership account information; the system accepts and records the changes.
in_scope_actions: Enter updated personal details (first name, last name, member ID)
Enter updated contact information (email address, phone)
excluded_adjacent_actions: Managing site-wide/global auction system defaults (Auction Administration / Manage Global Settings)
Downstream administrative or verification processes after saving
variant_dimensions: Which account fields are updated in a given instance (personal details, contact info, password)

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has an existing membership account with registration information (first name, last name, member ID, email address, phone) and a current password already stored in the system.
The Customer has an active authenticated session (is logged in).
The use case is triggered when the Customer accesses the account settings page, specifically the 'Change Membership Account Information' page, to update their stored membership account data.

The Customer views the 'My Current Information' section, which displays their existing First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, and Phone, and enters their Current Password to authorize changes.

The Customer enters updated values in the 'My New Information' section: First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address (entered twice for verification), Phone, and Password (entered twice for verification).

The Customer manages email notification preferences by selecting the desired checkboxes: 'notify me via email when I am outbid', 'notify me when I win an auction', and 'notify me when my winnings are shipped'.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to submit the updated membership account information.
The system returns the Customer to the My Account page.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of changing the in-page email notification checkboxes, the Customer may opt out of the 'Auction Insider' newsletter subscription by clicking the 'Change my "Auction Insider" Email Newsletter Subscription' link.

At main flow step 1, if the Customer has not completed the required current-password authorization, the system prevents modification of the membership account information. Exit: the update is blocked and no account changes are made.

At main flow step 3, if the Customer's payment type is PayPal or Amazon, the system grays out the 'Please notify me when I win an auction' checkbox, preventing the Customer from deselecting it. Exit: the attempted deselection is blocked and the checkbox remains selected.

At main flow step 4, if the Member ID ('Handle') entered in step 2 is already present in the customer table, the system raises an error state and the save is not accepted. Exit: the save attempt fails.

At main flow step 4, if the E-mail Address entered in step 2 duplicates an email already in the customer table, the system treats it as an error requiring correction and the save is not accepted. Exit: the save is rejected until the email is corrected.
At main flow step 4, if the two new-password fields contain mismatched values, the system rejects the save. Exit: the save attempt fails.
At main flow step 4, if the new password is outside the 8- to 12-character allowed range, the system triggers a validation error and prevents the save. Exit: the save attempt fails.

missing_aspects: Documented recovery/continuation path after the save is rejected by uniqueness or password validation failures.

claims.content: The Customer's updated membership account information (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, and Password) is saved to the system and persisted.

The Customer's selected email notification preferences ('notify me when I am outbid', 'notify me when I win an auction', 'notify me when my winnings are shipped') are saved and will govern future transactional email behavior.
After saving changes, the Customer is returned to the My Account page, confirming successful completion of the account settings update.
